name: Eliahua
title: David's son and Levitical singer
summary: Eliahua was one of King David's sons, born in Jerusalem. He is also mentioned among the Levitical singers appointed to serve in temple worship during David's organization of religious services.

keyEvents.title: Born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Eliata was born as one of David's sons in Jerusalem, after David had become king over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of David Born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Eliata is listed among the many sons who were born to David in Jerusalem during his reign.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as a Singer in Temple Service
keyEvents.description: A man named Eliata was appointed among Heman's sons to serve as a singer and musician in the temple service organized by David.

keyEvents.title: Service with Harp and Cymbal
keyEvents.description: Eliata was assigned the twentieth lot in the organization of the singing service, and he served together with his brothers and sons.
